lines.zh: 我跟着群走，鼻子一直在地上拱。
lines.en: I walk with the herd, snout forever rooting the ground.
I cross the leaf litter noisily.

lines.zh: 我走成一列，前后都是同伴。
lines.en: I go in a line with herdmates ahead and behind.

lines.zh: 我们一路走，一路把土翻起来。
lines.en: We walk and turn the soil as we go.
I move faster than I look.
I push that patch of earth open with my snout.
I follow the game trail.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了一下，又低下头。
lines.en: I lift my head once, then lower it again.

lines.zh: 我们穿过灌木，枝条被撞断。
lines.en: We push through the brush and branches snap.
I grunt as I walk.
My hooves land solidly.
I circle around a tree root.
I rub my back on a trunk.

lines.zh: 我抬着头，听林子的声音。
lines.en: I hold my head up and listen to the wood.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，谁也不走开。
lines.en: We crowd together and none of us leaves.
There is a white band at my jaw.
There are roots left in the soil.
I grunt low.
The mud here is good and cool.
I paw the ground twice.

lines.zh: 我在看那边有没有动静。
lines.en: I am watching to see if anything stirs.
A herdmate comes close and I hold still.
We carry a smell about us.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子抬起来，闻了闻风。
lines.en: I lift my snout and test the wind.
I lift my head and face you.
You are standing on our trail.
My snout works faster.
I nudge half a step your way.
I grunt, heavily.
Have you backed off?
I watch you for a while.
None of us care for strangers.

lines.zh: 你要是不走，我们就不客气了。
lines.en: If you do not leave, we will not be polite.

lines.zh: 我又往你那边靠了半步。
lines.en: I lean half a step your way.
The herd has all stopped.
Your hand moves; I'm watching it.
I tilt my head, breathing loudly.
This patch belongs to us now.
I squeal and push into the herd.
The pain makes me leap.
I turn with my teeth outward.
I give two steps, then shove back.
My grunting comes fast and short.
Blood reddens my snout.
I rub the wound against the ground.
I will not run; I only get fiercer.
Is that a root or fruit?
I smell it, strongly.
I come rooting my way over.
Put it on the ground.
I could crush it in one bite.
Herdmates have come along too.
This smell drowns out the rest.
I stretch my snout for it.
Step further back.
That is not enough for several of us.
You hit me and I shove back.
I shoulder you aside.
That was a solid hit.
The herdmates beside me move too.
I am crowded to one side.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子在泥里打了个滑。
lines.en: My hooves slip in the mud.

lines.zh: 我把四只蹄子重新踩住。
lines.en: I set all four hooves again.
Do not crowd into the herd.
I grunt low and turn back.
I follow her for a while.
We root at each other with our snouts.
The smell of the herd is stronger.
We press very close.
I pay nothing else any mind.

lines.zh: 我轻轻撞了撞她的侧腹。
lines.en: I bump her flank gently.
In these days we do not scatter.
We crowd in the shade.
I stand against her.
The herd closes around us.
I pushed it with my snout disc.
I push it into the mud.
I carry it a few steps.
Too hard; I cannot bite it.
A herdmate wants it; I turn away.
I sniff and drop it.
This one I keep.

lines.zh: 我用吻部把它拱进草丛。
lines.en: I nudge it into the grass with my snout.
I drop my head, teeth forward.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，全都听见了。
lines.en: I grunt, and everyone heard.
The herd gathers.
I charge at you.
No point running; you will not escape.
Head down means a gore.
I plant this step hard.

lines.zh: 我们不追远，但会追一段。
lines.en: We will not chase far, but we will chase.
You are standing in the middle of us.
My teeth clack.
I lunge forward again.

lines.zh: 它在我们中间，谁都能撞到。
lines.en: It is among us; anyone can hit it.
My angle is set.

lines.zh: 我身边的同伴也在准备。
lines.en: The herdmates beside me are readying too.
I run after you, hooves loud.
You go left; all of us go left.
We close in from both sides.
I do not stop; I can hear you.
We have trampled the grass flat.
I grunt as I run.
You are running too wildly.
We do not fear being hurt.
There is only our herd here.
I snap a branch as I go.
You look back and see the teeth.
I do not lose a step.
We press closer and closer.
You have backed against a tree.
That tree will not stop us.
Only the last few steps.
I lower my head and gore you over.
I slam my shoulder into your chest.
We charge in together.
I wrench my head and open a gash.
My teeth grind loudly.
That charge went wide.
I turn and charge again.
You are still on your feet.
There is blood in my mouth.
A herdmate lunges in next.
I am panting hard and have not backed off.

lines.zh: 这一下用力太猛，我差点绊倒。
lines.en: I put too much in and nearly tripped.

lines.zh: 林子那边传来一阵蹄声。
lines.en: A run of hooves comes from the trees.

lines.zh: 我先走出来，后面跟着一群。
lines.en: I come out first, the herd behind me.
We push out of the brush.

lines.zh: 土被翻起一片，是我们来了。
lines.en: The earth is turned over; we have arrived.
I stop at the treeline.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，同伴都听见了。
lines.en: I grunt, and the herd hears.
The ground is soft here, good for rooting.
I lower my head and start turning soil.
Our smell arrives before we do.
I come down the slope slowly.
I circle the area once first.
There is something under the roots.
We stop in this patch of wood.

lines.zh: 前面的路被我们踩出来了。
lines.en: We have worn a path ahead.
I settle, snout working.
There are a dozen or so in this herd.
I am walking at the front.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的背，我冲进泥里。
lines.en: Fire sweeps my back; I charge into the mud.
I fall into a hollow, hooves thrashing.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我拼命往岸上冲。
lines.en: Water fills my snout; I fight for the bank.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，滚了半圈。
lines.en: The blast flips me and I roll half a turn.

lines.zh: 一股力圈住我，我挣不开。
lines.en: Some force rings me in and I cannot break out.
Hunger leaves me too weak to root.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整只都木了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole body goes numb.

lines.zh: 脚下没有土，我刨不到任何东西。
lines.en: There is no soil, and my hooves find nothing.
